_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil with flat 30d return and no printed breaker makes HOLD the statistically honest call; bottom analog is forward context only, not a current rung shift.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative silent on forward phase/direction (flow vignette only), so no active conflict but no confirmation either
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound with 30d momentum near 0% and Fear & Greed holding roughly 45-60
next_move.invalidated_if: A range break that takes Fear & Greed out of the mid band — either a long-liquidation flush under ~40 or an ETF-flow rebound with upside follow-through
